::: {#def-homogeneous-network-interference .theorem}
## Homogeneous network interference

The assumption that an exposure mapping $g_{ti}$ is separable and all its [component functions](#def-separability) are [network exposure mappings](#def-network-exposure-mapping) with respect to some graph set $\mathcal H$. An NPSEM satisfies homogenous network interference if all its exposure mappings satisfy homogenous network interference. 


:::
